answer_prose: In the prior-best band of 3:30–4 hours, median finishes were 0.8% slower than that benchmark in Boston and 0.4% slower in Chicago. The charts show the much wider spread within each course; these are different fields, not a course ranking.
detail_prose: Prior-time bands improve comparability, but this is still a comparison of different people and race days.

charts.title: Performance and spread on each course
